project.name: Mikazuki X3 Android test player
project.build: 0.1.1-test; shared PC core, touch-only moonlit UI
target_devices: ARM64 Android 8+ phones; primary trial device iQOO Z9 Turbo
Android 11 x86_64 local emulator for host integration checks

player_decisions.decision: Mount the original disc and start or resume an edition
player_decisions.required_information: Supported ISO, real available editions and save slots

player_decisions.decision: Choose an original branch or menu action
player_decisions.required_information: Only revealed text, original valid options and focus

player_decisions.decision: Save progress or capture a reproducible issue
player_decisions.required_information: Original save eligibility, write result and visible source location

screens.entry: Mount a retained SAF descriptor and validate the original PVD, root and resource index
screens.exit: Create or load the shared ProjectGame session
screens.back_behavior: Subpage returns to title; system back from title leaves the Activity
screens.initial_focus: Touch target order follows the source edition list

screens.decision: Read, confirm, choose or inspect original menus
screens.entry: Original C++ state only; no screenshot or walkthrough chooses progression
screens.back_behavior: System back sends the original menu action, or cancel when an original menu is open
screens.initial_focus: Original focus, chapter row and actor index are read from core state

screens.decision: Choose text language, scanlines or read credits
screens.entry: Pause the tick queue, release held input and close the audio endpoint without resetting the mixer
screens.exit: Restore the same game session and audio mixer
screens.back_behavior: About returns to settings; settings returns to its prior title or game

screens.decision: Retry the preserved source operation or capture the failure
screens.entry: Expose the real error while retaining original state
screens.exit: Resume audio before restoring the failed save input, then restart the tick loop
screens.back_behavior: No automatic branch selection or successful-save claim

focus_order: Center direct choices and swipe lists
Right rail settings, capture and context-specific return
navigation.device_switch: Android gameplay uses touch only. Semantic touch and swipe requests still share original ChoiceInput with PC. No virtual D-pad or physical game-key mappings.
navigation.modal_behavior: Host settings pause original ticks; overwrite confirmation blocks gameplay; blank name/menu cells never become confirm
navigation.destructive_behavior: Replacing an existing PC-format slot requires confirmation; original card confirmations retain original yes/no indices

layout.safe_area: Inset actionable content using Android cutout and system-bar insets; landscape is enforced
anchors: Centered complete 4:3 scene, full safe height when rails fit
Settings, screenshot and contextual return on right
Small source location code in lower left rail
layout.text_scaling: Use density and safe height; fit localized rows without opaque dialogue panels; original eight-row name pages reserve their bottom toolbar
layout.reflow: Preserve the complete scene; shrink it when two rails cannot fit beside a full-height image
layout.scrolling: Up/down swipes enqueue original direction edges in chapter/time-chart/name grids. Horizontal name swipes send original group changes; ordinary page taps only confirm outside modal menus. No local script pagination.

localization.externalized: Shared validated story_locale_data.inc and system_locale_data.inc; small Android host labels currently live alongside their three language variants in MainActivity
localization.expansion: Wrap dialogue at word or CJK boundaries and fit all visible option rows; hit regions cover the entire displayed option
localization.bidirectional: Only the existing left-to-right ja/zh-Hans/en locales are declared
localization.fonts: Android system fonts with explicit text locale; original font atlas retained for Japanese source presentation and artwork
localization.input_glyphs: Semantic touch labels and line icons; no controller circle/cross or directional pad

signals: Focus has both a gold marker and a background distinction
Touch grid blanks do not submit the focused character
accessibility.settings_entry: Settings available at title after disc mount and on the right rail during gameplay
accessibility.motion: No added UI transitions; original scene transitions remain core-driven
accessibility.media_alternatives: Original audio remains unchanged; current dialogue is visible. Per-control TalkBack semantics and a separate large-text mode are not implemented in this test build

data_bindings.source: Shared ProjectGame, committed glyph events and original memory state
data_bindings.initial_state: Render selected language before exposing the first playable frame
data_bindings.update: One serial process-wide engine queue executes original ticks; publish an immutable JSON snapshot with its bitmap under frameLock
data_bindings.stale: Pause on lifecycle loss; no concurrent Activity can enter the native core
data_bindings.error: Preserve state and display the actual error
data_bindings.permission: Only core-exposed revealed text and valid choices are presented

data_bindings.initial_state: Validate length, PVD, root and FAD index
data_bindings.update: pread on an owned descriptor; per-resource size and SHA validation unchanged
data_bindings.stale: Ask the player to reselect an unavailable URI
data_bindings.error: Report unsupported or nonseekable input; do not copy or extract the full disc
data_bindings.permission: Read permission for the selected local file only; no Internet or broad storage permission

data_bindings.source: Original save eligibility and current immutable rendered state
data_bindings.initial_state: Only offer real slot files; separate background suspend snapshot
data_bindings.update: Atomic shared checkpoint writing; PNG via MediaStore on API29+ or create-document on API26-28
data_bindings.stale: A capture filename and visible code come from the same frameLock snapshot
data_bindings.error: Never report a failed write as a saved game
data_bindings.permission: Private app saves; user-visible screenshots with source locator, locale and filter in filename

matrix.state: Cold start, dialogue, save and cross-process resume
matrix.expected: Load original scene and restore sn2 11-0-9Y-FH8 after process restart

matrix.setting: 0.1.0 historical baseline: smooth to Scale2x; 0.1.1 exposes scanlines only
matrix.expected: Language switch retains tick6660 and location; filtered image and screenshot render

matrix.state: Real phone compatibility and sustained play
matrix.expected: Install, select ISO, play and save with usable safe areas and audio

matrix.state: 16KB pages, API26 screenshots and varied GPU drivers
matrix.setting: Standard Canvas, AAudio and 16KB ELF alignment
matrix.expected: No ABI, permission or display-specific dependency
matrix.status: static checks plus later real-device coverage; not claimed universally verified

matrix.state: Touch-only UI, direct interval target and original-input adapter
matrix.expected: No virtual Dpad or physical game keys; source-compatible actions and unchanged paused story position
matrix.status: Static ABI/JNI/source checks passed; see 0.1.1 report for dynamic evidence and limitations

acceptance: Deliver an installable ARM64 test APK that reads the original ISO
Preserve shared story, wait, branch, voice and save semantics
Report emulator, translated ARM and real-phone evidence separately
verification.evidence: analysis/android records APK hash, source fingerprint, exact start or save fixture, actions, capture code, JSON state and limits

decisions.decision: Reuse the PC core and translations; replace only platform I/O, decoding/output and touch presentation
decisions.basis: Project continuity and no independent story implementation

decisions.decision: Start with ARM64 API26+; add compatibility only after specific evidence
decisions.basis: User's iQOO Z9 Turbo test target and broad long-term compatibility preference

decisions.decision: Generated moonlit-island art is confined to host menus/rails; Canvas renders all text and thin-line controls
decisions.basis: User requests a thematic drawn UI, touch-only controls and scanlines only; no replacement of original game images

route_out.next_owner: Android runtime and user device validation
route_out.reason: First-test integration; full mobile accessibility and device matrix remain later work
